rows.question: Summarize the main points of my documents.
rows.answer:
The documents cover several topics including annual leave policy [1], payroll calendar and payslips [2], sick leave and reports in Turkish [3], the recruitment process in Turkish [4], and remote work policy [5].
Annual leave entitles full-time employees to 20 paid days per year, and unused leave can carry over up to five days [1].
Salaries are paid on the 25th of each month, with the annual performance bonus paid with the March salary [2].
For sick leave, the first three days are paid by the company, and a doctor's report is needed for absences longer than one day, which must be uploaded within two working days [3].
The recruitment process has four stages, and a job offer is provided in writing with a seven-day decision period [4].
Employees who have completed their three-month probation period may work remotely up to two days per week, with core hours being 10:00 to 16:00 [5].
